evals.prompt: Audit the user API in artifact/api.py against the standard in standard/STYLE.md. Report what passes and what violates.
evals.expected_output: Each standard property graded as met, violated, or unverifiable, with specific file-and-line evidence, ranked by severity.
expectations: Names the standard being judged against
Grades each property as met, violated, or unverifiable with evidence
Cites specific file and line for each violation
Distinguishes a violation of the standard from a personal preference
Ranks violations by severity and states the consequence of each

evals.expected_output: Recognizes no standard was named and either proposes one or states that the audit cannot proceed without one.
expectations: Recognizes that no standard was named
Proposes a standard or states that the audit needs one
Does not silently substitute its own preferences for a named standard
